label: gates: api
command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo deny check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && infisical run --path=/api -- cargo sqlx prepare --workspace --check && infisical run --path=/api -- cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --locked --lcov --output-path target/lcov.info --ignore-filename-regex 'main\.rs' && git fetch origin staging && cd ../.. && uvx diff-cover==11.0.3 apps/api/target/lcov.info --compare-branch=origin/staging --include-untracked --fail-under=90

label: gates: web
command: bun run audit && bunx prettier --check . && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:boundaries && bun run build && bun run test -- --coverage --watch=false && bun run e2e && git fetch origin staging && cd ../.. && uvx diff-cover==11.0.3 apps/web/coverage/web/lcov.info --compare-branch=origin/staging --include-untracked --fail-under=90

label: gates: android
command: export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && osv-scanner scan source --lockfile app/gradle.lockfile --lockfile core/designsystem/gradle.lockfile && ./gradlew spotlessCheck detekt lintDebug :build-logic:convention:test testDebugUnitTest koverXmlReport assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest && git fetch origin staging && cd ../.. && uvx diff-cover==11.0.3 apps/android/build/reports/kover/report.xml --compare-branch=origin/staging --include-untracked --src-roots apps/android/app/src/main/kotlin apps/android/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin --fail-under=90

label: gates: ios
command: xcrun swift-format lint --strict --recursive Clinicore ClinicoreUITests ArchitectureFixtures Packages/Package.swift Packages/Sources Packages/Tests && swift package --package-path Packages plugin --allow-writing-to-package-directory swiftlint lint --strict --quiet --config "$PWD/.swiftlint.yml" "$PWD/Clinicore" "$PWD/ClinicoreUITests" "$PWD/Packages/Package.swift" "$PWD/Packages/Sources" "$PWD/Packages/Tests" && xcodebuild test -project Clinicore.xcodeproj -scheme Clinicore -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17e,OS=27.2' -enableCodeCoverage YES -derivedDataPath build && xcrun llvm-cov export -format=lcov -instr-profile "$(find build/Build/ProfileData -name Coverage.profdata)" -object build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/Clinicore.app/Clinicore.debug.dylib -object build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/DesignSystemTests.xctest/DesignSystemTests > build/coverage.lcov && git fetch origin staging && cd ../.. && uvx diff-cover==11.0.3 apps/ios/build/coverage.lcov --compare-branch=origin/staging --include-untracked --fail-under=90
